headline: Russia's jet-powered drones bring empty Kyiv supermarket shelves and rattle Ukrainians
context: Russian forces relentlessly battered Kyiv and cities in the region around the Ukrainian capital for a fifth straight day, leaving some supermarket shelves bare after repeated strikes on warehouses.
